reviewItem.question: Does "Local Redirect Policy, when enabled with socket-based load-balancing, redirects traffic from policy-selected node-local backends destined to the policy's…" mean a change to crd-field:cilium|group=cilium.io|kind=CiliumLocalRedirectPolicy|path=spec.skipRedirectFromBackend (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: With socket-based load-balancing, Local Redirect Policy now by default redirects traffic from policy-selected node-local backends destined to the policy's frontend back to the node-local backends; set skipRedirectFromBackend to true to override.
